Oneliner

Landing on the Moon with a suite of instruments similar to BioSentinel CubeSat.
Description

Fly a tech demo payload based on a SWIR camera. The project was funded by the The Wolfson Foundation.

In 2026, the LEIC, a 4U CubeSat, is planned to be launched, with the aim of landing on the Moon with a suite of instruments similar to BioSentinel CubeSat to investigate how lunar surface environment affects biological responses.
Notes

The pictures are from training at ISISpace and may not be the eventual satellite.
